articles.summary: Across the globe, home energy management systems are evolving fast. Solar panels are becoming a standard feature on many homes, and batteries are becoming popular additions as net metering is phased out and self-consumption increases in value.
articles.title: Introducing the HEM System: a unified API for solar and home batteries

articles.summary: On September 12, 2025, the EU Data Act became fully applicable across the EU. This comprehensive report explores the regulation’s coverage, practical implications, and how energy companies can leverage it to create value.
articles.title: The EU Data Act: what it means for the energy industry
